title: Tend — Binary founder pitch
status: DRAFT — local render only; not submitted or published

scenes.title: A market view. A fixed maximum loss.
captions: Tend is a testnet prototype for defined-risk BTC, ETH, and MON trades on Monad.
A trader chooses a direction and knows the premium at risk before entry.
scenes.footer: No user, production, or profitability claim

scenes.title: Pick a total winning payout tier.
captions: Each quote has a fixed total winning payout: one point five, two, or three times the charged premium.
The premium is the maximum trading loss, excluding network gas.
scenes.footer: Fixed payout tier · premium is maximum loss

scenes.title: Only expiry settles a held position.
captions: UP pays only when the final settlement price is strictly above the signed strike.
DOWN pays only when it is strictly below. A tie loses, and an earlier cross is irrelevant.
scenes.footer: Expiry price decides · not an intraday trigger

scenes.title: One tick. Fully escrowed obligation.
captions: A one raw price tick width makes the current quote an expiry-only binary result.
Before the position opens, the pool vault locks the maximum payout for that quote.
scenes.footer: Monad testnet escrow · no margin account

scenes.title: A real testnet loss path, checked end to end.
captions: On September twenty-eighth, an operator command-line wallet opened Monad testnet position four.
It paid ten mUSDC for a two-times ticket, with a maximum payout of twenty mUSDC and a one-tick UP strike of eighty-four thousand, five hundred seventy-five point one nine eight six six seven dollars.
scenes.footer: Operator CLI position · not a browser-wallet confirmation

scenes.title: The final price finished below the UP strike.
captions: At expiry, the Coinbase reference was eighty-four thousand, four hundred twenty dollars and nineteen cents, below the UP strike.
The on-chain payout was zero. That verifies a loss case, not a profitable trade.
scenes.footer: Strict expiry-only result verified for position #4

scenes.title: Useful proof, clear limits.
captions: This draft uses valueless testnet mUSDC and MockPyth, which does not authenticate oracle attestations.
Tend still needs authenticated settlement, reliable operations, independent review, and user testing before real funds.
scenes.footer: DRAFT · local-only render · no hackathon submission
